env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A tuple type holds an option field of a value type and of a pointer
# type in every type position: a parameter, a variable, a slice, an
# array, a map value, a struct field and a tuple type nested in a tuple
# type. The module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds
# and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the
# same ok lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_types.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_types.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_types.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_types.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tupleoptiontypes

go 1.27
